sites.name: Fansipan Peak
sites.event: Known as the 'Roof of Indochina' (3,143m), a symbol of conquest for Lao Cai tourism.

place.commune: Fansipan Ward (bordering Tam Duong, Lai Chau)

sites.name: Hoang A Tuong Palace (Cat King Palace)
sites.event: A unique architectural work combining Asian and European styles, the residence of 'Cat King' Hoang A Tuong, the local chieftain who governed the ancient Bac Ha region.

sites.name: Sapa Ancient Rock Field
sites.event: A national monument, preserving hundreds of sandstone boulders carved with undeciphered ancient drawings and characters of prehistoric people.

sites.name: O Quy Ho Pass
sites.event: One of the 'Four Great Passes' of Vietnam, associated with the legend of the O Quy Ho bird and its plaintive call searching for its mate.

place.commune: O Quy Ho Ward (bordering Lai Chau)

sites.name: Thuong Temple
sites.event: The place of worship for the Grand Duke Hung Dao Dai Vuong Tran Quoc Tuan, who once stationed his troops here to guard the border.

sites.name: Ham Rong Mountain
sites.event: The mountain shaped like a dragon's head reaching up to the blue sky, associated with the legend of a pair of dragons separated by a great deluge.

sites.name: Lung Po Flagstaff
sites.event: The monument marking sovereignty where the Red River flows into Vietnamese territory ('Where the Red River flows into Vietnam').

sites.name: Bao Ha Temple (Ong Hoang Bay Temple)
sites.event: A national historical and cultural relic, dedicated to the famous general Nguyen Hoang Bay (National Guardian Deity) who had the merit of fighting northern invaders.

sites.name: Y Ty Terraced Fields
sites.event: Famous for its sea of clouds and the unique mushroom-shaped earthen houses of the Ha Nhi people.

sites.name: Bac Ha Market
sites.event: The largest highland market that still preserves the pristine cultural features of ethnic minorities in the Northwest region.

sites.name: Lao Cai International Border Gate
sites.event: An important trading gateway between Vietnam and China, a witness to many historical border events.
